name: Ki Pool (Su)
category: Everyman Gaming, LLC – Rogue Talents, Advanced
body:
Prerequisite(s): Advanced talents

Benefit(s): A rogue that selects this talent gains a ki pool, as the ninja class feature. The rogue may choose whether she adds her Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma modifier to the number of points in her ki pool; once this choice has been made, it cannot be changed.
